title: Mevug
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Zevachim 9b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.9b.4), where, in Hyman’s account, Rav Yehudah spoke in his name. [Rashi explains](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Zevachim.9b.4.1) that this is a sage’s name.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Bavli instead has Rav speaking in Mevug’s name, both here and in the alternate formulations at [9b:9](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.9b.9), [9b:13](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.9b.13) and [9b:14](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.9b.14). [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2431&lang=en) likewise names Rav. Rashi calls Mevug a sage’s name.
